segments.note: THE OPENER, and it is actually Party Cove. Wide down a long line of rafted boats with foam across the water and the crowd standing in it, 24 May 2025. REPLACES a shot pulled on 14 Sep 2026: the previous opener and closer both came from Party Cove/2025-09-27, which the owner identified as mis-filed - that whole folder is footage from The Dam. They were 15.5 of 49 seconds and the two bookends.

Boats nose to nose with people in the water between them and a float pad alongside. Held window verified 1.5-11s. Output sheet showed the first two seconds thin - open water and three distant heads - so the window starts at 4.5s where the boats fill the frame.
The blue float pad with people on it and a woman in a ring float. Window 6-24s is continuous; after 30s the pad fills the frame and the shot dies.
THE DOG on the float. Nothing else in the library has it, and a detail nobody expects is worth more than another wide. Verified at 17.4 and again at 42.7.
Groups standing chest-deep, talking, drinks in hand - the sandbar as a social place rather than a boat park. Verified 34-46s.

The white canopy pitched in the shallows, the flag, boats behind. Late in the clip is the good half: the first 40s is mostly a straw hat at arm's length. Moved off 49.0s: the output sheet caught a close-up of one guest still on screen there. The canopy is clear from 50.5s.
Boats strung out along the treeline with people wading between them. Verified 25.8-34.3s.
